evidence_cards.content: When transmitting a J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) original message or a retransmission due to data change, the Periodic Report Indicator (PER IND) shall be set to value 1. Periodic updates following the original or retransmitted message shall be transmitted with the Periodic Report Indicator set to value 2. Responses to Data Update Requests for multi-point tracks shall be transmitted with the PER IND set to value 0 and the Response Indicator Track value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the flow of periodic reporting and update responses for tracks managed by the C2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: For each of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields, the JU shall accept all defined field values for retransmission and operator appreciation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a primary action in the main flow where the C2 JU processes and manages track identity fields for retransmission.

evidence_cards.content: Values accepted for retransmission shall be retransmitted if the JU assumes R², unless the JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement (non-NS) for the field which differs from the value accepted for retransmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the decision logic in the main flow regarding when to transmit retransmitted values versus locally derived data based on the R² responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: In the case where the JU holds locally derived non-NS data differing from the accepted value, the JU shall report the locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the specific action taken in the main flow when the local data priority condition is met.

evidence_cards.content: As an exception to the local priority rule, non-NS data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit for the track shall be retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a conditional branch in the main flow where specific identity fields from the controlling unit override local data.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific conditional action in the main flow for handling the Special Interest Indicator field.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU assumes responsibility (R²) for a track if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds, or on a locally held Land (Ground) track for approximately 120 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a primary logic step for the C2 JU to acquire track responsibility based on time thresholds for real-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a locally held track, it shall assume responsibility (R²) at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received. Prior to this, for an air or surface track after a Drop Track message, a correlation test must be conducted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific condition under which the C2 JU assumes track responsibility based on a J7.0 message reception.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU is holding a nonreal-time track with the TQ field set to value 0, it shall assume responsibility (R²) for that track when it is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes how the C2 JU assumes responsibility for non-real-time tracks based on the TQ field and report updates.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU receives a J2 PPLI message from another JU (with NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure), it may assume responsibility (R²) for the track at the next opportunity to transmit, provided local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes how the C2 JU assumes responsibility based on the status indicators in a J2 PPLI message.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU relinquishes responsibility (R²) for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report where the remote Track Quality (TQ) is greater than the local TQ, or when the remote TQ is equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Station Number (STN) is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the logic for the C2 JU to give up track responsibility based on TQ comparison or STN hierarchy.

evidence_cards.content: Once the C2 JU has assumed responsibility (R²) for a track, it retains that responsibility until it is relinquished according to specific rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the duration of the responsibility state for the C2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU receives a J7.0 message with Track Management Action set to 0 (Drop Track Report) for a locally held track, it assumes R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track, provided local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific behavior in the main flow for a JU receiving a drop track request for a local track.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track (TQ field 0) assumes R² when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report. A JU reporting a nonreal-time track has R² regardless of the time value in the report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the main flow logic for assuming R² on nonreal-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a main flow step for relinquishing responsibility based on Time Quality (TQ) comparison.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² retains responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the persistence of the R² state in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ, provided the remote Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific condition for relinquishing R² based on Source Track Number (TN) comparison when TQ is equal.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R² and the TNs are the same, the JU shall accept the PPLI information into its environment, delete the surveillance data on the specific track (except when Point Type is 0), and set the Track Number and Identity Type fields to the PPLI values.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.2 message shall not be used to correlate one track/point with any other point, as there is no interface track-to-point or point-to-point correlation.

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to change the Point Type and/or Point Amplification value of a reference point while retaining the same Reference TN, except that a Point Amplification value of No Statement may be changed to a non-No Statement value and retain the same Reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific conditional flow for updating track attributes.

evidence_cards.content: Emergency points are transmitted as J3.1 messages. The J3.1 message shall contain, as amplifying information, the TN, Previously Reported that is associated with the emergency point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the main flow for reporting emergency points.

evidence_cards.content: The emergency point shall have a TN, Reference different from the TN, Previously Reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a data requirement in the reporting sequence.

evidence_cards.content: When the J3.0 message is used to report a point, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field shall be set to value 0, Point, in the initial word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a formatting step in the reporting process.

evidence_cards.content: When altitude is specified, Altitude, 100 Ft 1 and, if appropriate Altitude, 100 Ft 2, shall be reported in each J3.0E0 word transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the specific data fields passed during altitude reporting.

evidence_cards.content: If only one altitude is to be reported, the Altitude, 100 Ft 1 shall be used and Altitude, 100 Ft 2 shall be set to value 1023, No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the action taken when the system handles a single altitude value.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU transmits a J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) original message or a retransmission due to data change, the Periodic Report Indicator (PER IND) shall be set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the main flow action for setting the Periodic Report Indicator during initial or retransmitted message transmission.

evidence_cards.content: Periodic updates following the original or retransmitted message shall be transmitted with the Periodic Report Indicator set to value 2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the main flow action for transmitting subsequent periodic updates of points.

evidence_cards.content: Responses to Data Update Requests for multi-point areas or multi-segmented lines (defined by more than one J3.0 message) shall be transmitted with the PER IND set to value 0 and the Response Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the main flow action for responding to data update requests with specific indicator values.

evidence_cards.content: A change of positional information for a point, line, or area with independent course and speed does not, in itself, constitute a change of data for the purpose of setting the Periodic Report Indicator to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a boundary condition for the main flow logic regarding when the Periodic Report Indicator should or should not be set to 1.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if the local/remote data held indicates the tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict, as defined in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1i.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a mandatory automatic restriction step in the track correlation process.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if they have different Mode II codes, provided the local Mode II code is current.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a mandatory automatic restriction step in the track correlation process.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks being updated with local positional data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a mandatory automatic restriction step in the track correlation process.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not inhibit correlation if either track has the Strength field set to No Statement, even if other tracks have a Strength value greater than 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition for the correlation restriction step.

evidence_cards.content: If the actions taken to resolve an ID conflict result in a resolution, the Track Number (TN) to be retained shall be tested for decorrelation in accordance with paragraph 4.4.4.3.2a before executing the correlation, except that the test shall be conducted only once.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim describes a procedural step executed by the C2 JU to prepare for or execute the correlation, fitting the definition of the main interaction sequence.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically select as the TN to be dropped a TN which has any of the OCCs listed in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1g(6 7); in the absence of such a selection constraint, JUs shall select the higher TN as the TN to be dropped.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the action taken by the system to re-designate the retained track after a correlation is finalized.

evidence_cards.content: If the own unit has R² for the Dropped TN, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message shall be transmitted for the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the data transmission action required by the C2 JU to inform other units about the dropped track.

evidence_cards.content: If the Dropped TN is reported by another IU after transmission of the J7.0, the own unit shall retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after transmission of the J7.0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the system behavior (retaining as remote and inhibiting re-correlation) in response to a specific incoming event (re-reporting of dropped track).

evidence_cards.content: If the Dropped TN had the Force Tell Indicator set to value 1, the Retained TN shall have the Force Tell Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a conditional update to track identity data during the transfer of identity (decorrelation process).

evidence_cards.content: If the Dropped TN had the Emergency Indicator set to value 1, the Retained TN shall have the Emergency Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a conditional update to track identity data during the transfer of identity (decorrelation process).

evidence_cards.content: If Track TN A is the Target TN of a J10.2 Engagement Status message for a current engagement against a surface track, or the Reference TN of a J10.2 message, the system shall issue a J10.2 message with the Weapon Engagement Status field set to value 8 (Engagement Broken) if appropriate.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details a specific action taken by the C2 JU during the decorrelation process.

evidence_cards.content: Common local tracks shall be decorrelated if, on receipt of 2(1-5, 1) consecutive remote track reports, the remote track falls outside a distance of 135(1TN-2.0, 0) controlled by maximum correlation distance of own calculated accuracy, according to Vaxtra Report 14.4.3.1.6(3).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides the specific quantitative threshold and logic for automatically triggering a decorrelation action.

evidence_cards.content: The JU shall accept all defined field values (Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator) for retransmission and operator appreciation when assuming R² for a previously-reported track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the initial reception behavior for the C2 JU when handling incoming identity data for a track it is taking responsibility for.

evidence_cards.content: Values accepted for retransmission shall be retransmitted by the JU assuming R², unless the JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement (non-NS) for the field which differs from the value accepted for retransmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the primary logic for how the JU updates and retransmits track identity fields based on its local state versus incoming data.

evidence_cards.content: In the latter case (where local data differs), the JU shall report the locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the outcome of the conflict between incoming retransmitted data and locally held identity data.

evidence_cards.content: Non-NS data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit for the track shall be retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies an exception to the primary logic where incoming identity data takes precedence over local data for specific fields.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a mandatory retransmission condition for the Special Interest Indicator field.

evidence_cards.content: When contact is lost, the C2 JU reports the track as a DATUM.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is the core action taken by the primary actor in this use case when a specific condition (loss of contact) occurs.

evidence_cards.content: The decision to report a DATUM shall be an operator function.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a specific step in the sequence: the operator must make the decision before the system reports the DATUM.

evidence_cards.content: The DATUM is reported in a J3.4 message using the same Reference TN as the track for which contact has been lost.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the system's data handling behavior during the flow.

evidence_cards.content: The Data Report Type (DRT) field is set to 4 (DATUM).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact data content generated by the system as part of the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The ASW Time Function field is set to 3 (Time Contact Lost) or 1 (Time Datum Established).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact data content generated by the system as part of the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The Hour and Minute field is set to the truncated time that the contact was lost or DATUM was established.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact data content generated by the system as part of the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The Latitude, Longitude, 15 Meters Depth, and Depth Contact fields are set to the last known position.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track (i.e., TQ field set to value 0) shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report. A JU reporting a nonreal-time track has R² regardless of the time value in the track report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific logic for assuming R² responsibility for nonreal-time tracks based on local updates.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.

evidence_cards.content: After applying all the above rules, a JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs.

evidence_cards.content: Surveillance information includes: Point surveillance data (J3.0 Reference Point, J3.1 Emergency Point), Air/Surface data (J3.2 Air Track, J3.3 Surface Track), Subsurface data (J3.4 Subsurface Track), Land data (J3.5 Land Point/Track), Space data (J3.6 Space Track), and EW data (J3.7 EW Product).

evidence_cards.content: To distinguish between live tracks involved in an exercise and other live tracks being reported, the system must set the Exercise Indicator in the J3 track messages.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JU shall not automatically correlate if either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1.

evidence_cards.content: For Air and Surface track decorrelation, if a Dropped TN is a local or common local track, its data (Latitude, Longitude, Course, Speed, Altitude, Altitude Source, TOC, etc.) is transferred to the Retained TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the data transfer requirements during track decorrelation, a key part of managing track identity.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a specific interaction step in the main flow where the C2 JU detects a discrepancy and executes a protocol (sending a J7.0 message) to resolve it, which is the core activity of 'Managing Track Identity Classification'.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific procedural section for track resolution, contextualizing the main flow logic.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, on a locally held track assumes R2 at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the main flow action for a C2 JU (JU) when it receives a 'Drop Track Report' command for a track it is holding.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R2 for a nonreal-time track (TQ field set to value 0) assumes R2 for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the main flow logic for a JU assuming track responsibility (R2) for nonreal-time tracks based on local update conditions.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the main flow condition where a JU gives up responsibility for a real-time track upon receiving a newer remote report.

evidence_cards.content: After applying other rules, a JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific tie-breaking step in the main flow for relinquishing track responsibility based on Source Track Numbers.

evidence_cards.content: NonC2 JUs shall process J7.0 messages with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, for locally held remote tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a required action in the main flow: processing specific J7.0 messages to manage remote tracks.

evidence_cards.content: nonC2 JUs may have the capability to automatically purge locally held remote tracks after a specified time interval when these tracks are no longer being updated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an optional behavior in the main flow regarding the maintenance and purging of track data.

evidence_cards.content: When the standard identity of a track is 'Friend', it can be modified by the exercise identity. Specifically, if the Exercise Indicator is set to value 0 (Non-Exercise Track), the track identity shall be specified in the Identity field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific alternative path where standard identity handling is overridden by exercise parameters when the Exercise Indicator is 0.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU assumes responsibility (R²) of an Interface Unit (IU) as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG if it has correlated local sensor data and one of the following conditions is met: a) a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds; b) a J2 PPLI message (other than J2.0) is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence; c) a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for the IU; or d) the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This section defines specific conditions under which the C2 JU assumes responsibility (R²) in alternative states (inactive, limited status, or track discontinuity). This is a divergence from the standard correlation flow, detailing how to handle tracks that are no longer receiving active PPLI updates or have been dropped.

evidence_cards.content: When assuming R² due to inactivity or limited status, the C2 JU reports the IU using the Identity as 'Friend', and retains the previously received Track Number, Platform, and Platform Activity values. The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator fields must be reported as value 1 and maintained if another C² JU assumes R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim specifies the specific reporting behavior (an alternative path in the main flow) for tracks that have lost activity, defining how identity information is handled when the primary source data is no longer updating.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is not found, the C2 JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database. If no subsequent J2 messages are received and the C2 JU has no local data, it assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is an alternative flow step triggered when initial correlation fails and no subsequent data is received, leading to a state where the system is relieved of reporting responsibility for that subject.

evidence_cards.content: If position or other data in a PPLI meets decorrelation criteria, the C2 JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number. The PPLI Track Number, Identity Indicator field, and PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field shall all be reported as No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific alternative flow path for decorrelation events, requiring the system to break the link to the incoming track data and generate a new local track entry with specific 'No Statement' indicators.

evidence_cards.content: If a track change from live to simulated is detected (or a J2/J3 message arrives for a track received from an FJU), the C2 JU accepts the change, reports the most current IFF/SIF data, and if all IFF/SIF nonzero mode codes were obtained from processing commands, sets the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator to value 2; otherwise, sets it to value 1 if the code matches the Mode II code from the J2 message, or 0 if it does not.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines specific logic for handling track state transitions and conditional reporting of IFF/SIF indicators, which constitutes an alternative flow from the standard live track reporting path.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU has a limited track capacity (e.g., F-15), it must manage its database to ensure that Force Tell and Emergency alerts are not lost, implying a prioritization flow for high-urgency alerts over standard tracking data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a system behavior/alternative path taken when resource constraints (limited capacity) are encountered.

evidence_cards.content: When a system displays both simulated and live tracks simultaneously, it must use a distinguishable string of characters for the TN (Track Number) to differentiate them.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an alternative display or reporting mechanism required for simulated tracks when they coexist with live ones.

evidence_cards.content: If the two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict, automatic correlation is inhibited, unless the system's initialization parameter inhibits this restriction.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific branch in the correlation logic where automatic correlation is blocked due to ID conflicts.

evidence_cards.content: If the two tracks have different Mode II codes and the local code is current, automatic correlation is inhibited, unless the system's initialization parameter inhibits this restriction.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific branch in the correlation logic where automatic correlation is blocked due to conflicting Mode II codes.

evidence_cards.content: If both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks (being updated with local positional data), automatic correlation is prohibited.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific branch in the correlation logic where automatic correlation is prohibited to prevent mixing redundant local tracks.

evidence_cards.content: If either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1, automatic correlation is prohibited, unless the Strength is set to 'No Statement'.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific branch in the correlation logic where automatic correlation is prohibited based on the track Strength field.

evidence_cards.content: If the automatic correlation test against remote tracks (performed after a decorrelation determination) fails, the C2 JU assigns a new TN (TN B) to the local track and reports TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall retransmit values for retransmission fields (Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, Special Interest Indicator) if it assumes R², unless the JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement (non-NS) that differs from the received value.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a divergent path from the main flow of identity processing, where locally derived data takes precedence over incoming track data.

evidence_cards.content: In the exception case where locally derived data differs from the received retransmission value, the C2 JU shall report the locally derived data instead of the received data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact action taken in the alternative flow defined by the existence of differing local data.

evidence_cards.content: Regardless of locally derived data, the C2 JU must retransmit non-NS data received from the controlling unit for the fields Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a specific exception to the general rule regarding locally derived data, mandating retransmission of authoritative data from the controlling unit.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it must be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R², regardless of locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a specific mandatory behavior for a specific field (Special Interest Indicator), creating an alternative to standard local processing logic.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU is not receiving a remote track report (R²) or a locally held Air or Surface track has not received a remote report for approximately 40 seconds, or a locally held Land (Ground) track for approximately 20 seconds, and Identity, IFF/SIF, or Strength differences are resolved by transmitting the appropriate J7.0 (ACT=0) message, reporting eligibility remains and no remote report has been received on that track for 4.5 minutes. In this case, the C2 JU shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track message at the next opportunity and transmit the J5 (Track Reporting) message with the TQ field set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative flow for handling stale tracks where the standard reporting continuity (R²) is lost or broken, diverging from the main flow of normal track reporting.

evidence_cards.content: When a C2 JU relinquishes R² for a real-time Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) track upon reception of a remote track report in which the remote Track Number (TN) is greater than the local TN, the JU shall transmit a Drop Track Report for the track which contains a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the JU's STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This details a specific condition where the C2 JU transfers responsibility (relinquishes R²), which is a variation of the standard track management flow.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU with R² on a track retains responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the Active rules or the track is no longer within the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This provides an alternative condition for track retention compared to standard automatic correlation or time-out logic.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received containing the Track Number (TN), the assumption of reporting responsibility (R2) is released.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific condition under which a JU relinquishes responsibility for a track, allowing another JU to assume it.

evidence_cards.content: If a J3.4 message containing the TN is not received for two consecutive periodic updates, the assumption of reporting responsibility (R2) is released.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a timeout-based condition for releasing reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a Subsurface Interface Unit (IU) returns to the interface as an Active IU, the C2 JU holding R2 must cease reporting the IU, but must not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific protocol for reverting an inactive track back to active status without standard drop track procedures.

evidence_cards.content: If a Track Number (TN) has been previously reported on an IU using an address other than the IU's own address (dual designation), a J7.2 message may be used to resolve the conflict to the IU's address.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a resolution method for conflicting track identity assignments.

evidence_cards.content: In the event of a conflict between locally derived information and information reported on the interface, the C2 JU resolves the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific condition for relinquishing responsibility (R2) that acts as an alternative path to the primary rules (like time-out or receiving a drop message).

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a divergence in responsibility handling for ballistic missile tracks versus launch points, providing an alternative flow for managing related track data.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU holds the Dropped TN as a local or common local track, the Retained TN shall be designated as a common local track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative path for handling the 'Dropped TN' where the unit retains the track identity as a common local track.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU has R² for the Dropped TN, it must transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message. If the dropped track is reported by another IU after transmission, the unit shall retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt correlation for 60 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative path and exception handling where the unit transmits a drop message but must handle subsequent reports from other units without re-correlating.

evidence_cards.content: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed and all processing cancelled if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a time-out exception flow for the correlation execution process.

evidence_cards.content: In the absence of selection constraints (specific OCCs), the C2 JU shall select the higher TN as the TN to be dropped. If one TN is greater than 07777 and the other is less, the track with TN greater than 07777 is used in the comparison.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the logic for an alternative path in track number selection (choosing which track is dropped based on number value).

evidence_cards.content: If automatic correlation fails, the C2 JU shall assign a new Track Number (TN B) to the local track and report it in a J3.2 or J3.3 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the alternative flow action when the track identity correlation test is not satisfied, diverging from the standard process of retaining the existing track number.

evidence_cards.content: Values accepted for retransmission shall be retransmitted if the JU assumes R2, unless the JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement (non-NS) for the field which differs from the value accepted for retransmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an alternative logic path (diverging from the main flow of simply accepting and retransmitting) based on the availability of locally derived data.

evidence_cards.content: In the case where the JU holds locally derived non-NS data that differs from the value accepted for retransmission, the JU shall report the locally derived data instead.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact action taken in the alternative path (overriding the retransmission value with local data).

evidence_cards.content: As an exception to the standard rule, non-NS data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit for the track shall be retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception branch to the alternative flow where local data is overridden by data from the controlling unit.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R2.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU has R² for a track but does not receive a remote report on an Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds, or on a Land (Ground) track for approximately 120 seconds, it assumes R² for that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific alternative path where a C2 JU retains responsibility due to a timeout in receiving reports, diverging from the main flow of relinquishing responsibility upon reception of other reports.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU receives a J7.0 message with ACT = 0 on a locally held track and local reporting eligibility remains, it assumes R² at the next opportunity to transmit. If this occurs after a Drop Track message, a correlation test is conducted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative path for assuming R² triggered by the receipt of a specific J7.0 message, including a conditional sub-step for correlation testing.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU has R² for a nonreal-time track with the TQ field set to 0, and the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report, the JU assumes R² for that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an alternative path for nonreal-time tracks where local updates trigger the assumption of R².

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU receives a J2 PPLI message with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure from a JU that has R², it may assume R² at the next opportunity if local reporting eligibility remains.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative path where the reception of specific status indicators (Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, TDS Failure) triggers the assumption of R².

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon receiving a remote track report where the remote TQ is greater than the local TQ, or where the remote TQ is equal to the local TQ and the remote JU's STN is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the alternative path conditions under which the C2 JU must relinquish its responsibility (R²) in favor of another unit.

evidence_cards.content: Once the C2 JU assumes R² on a track, it retains responsibility until the R² is relinquished according to the defined rules or until the track is dropped.

In that case, the JU shall report the locally derived data, with the exception of non-NS data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit (which must be retransmitted regardless) and the Special Interest Indicator field (which must be retransmitted as value 1 if set to 1).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific exception path in the track management workflow where the local JU's state diverges from the remote data, dictating the specific action to take (report local data vs. retransmit remote data).

evidence_cards.content: Upon detection of a SURVEILLANCE DATA DIFFERENCE (Position, Velocity, Altitude/Elevation) or TDS Failure, the C2 JU shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until the discrepancy is resolved through correlation processing and shall generate a J7.0 (ACT = 2) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific exception handling path triggered by data conflicts, defining the mandatory action (transmit J7.0 ACT=2) and suspension of normal reporting.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU determines that a difference between remote and local tracks is caused by the tracks being used to report the same target (duplicate tracks), it shall resolve the issue by transmitting the appropriate J7 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception flow for resolving Duplicate Track scenarios.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU may transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 2) message in cases where operational necessity requires a shorter wait time or none at all (regarding the resolution of track differences).

evidence_cards.content: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator shall be reported as value 0 (No Statement).

evidence_cards.content: The PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator in the J2 message is reported as value 21 if the Mode II code was obtained from graphics (4.6); if the Mode II code is the same as the J2 message, the indicator is reported as value 1; otherwise, it is reported as value 0.

evidence_cards.content: Simulated tracks shall have the Simulation Indicator set to value 1.

evidence_cards.content: When a system receives a Reset to No Statement value, it shall automatically revert the locally held value of that field to No Statement.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU retransmits the Special Interest Indicator as value 1 if it was set to value 1 in the received track data, regardless of locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the final state of a specific track identity field after the C2 JU processes and retransmits the track data, which is a key postcondition of the classification handling process.

evidence_cards.content: For tracks where the C2 JU assumes R², non-No Statement (non-NS) data for Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit are retransmitted by the JU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the state of the track data in the surveillance network after the C2 JU has processed and retransmitted the track identity fields, ensuring continuity of critical control data.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU assumes R² (Responsibility for Reporting) for a track if it has local real-time data and nonreal-time data that has not been received from another JU (derived from other than integrated sensors), and the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific postcondition where the C2 JU takes control of a track based on data availability and update conditions.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU relinquishes R² (Responsibility for Reporting) for a track when it receives a remote track report with a Time Quality (TQ) value greater than the local TQ, or when the remote TQ is equal to the local TQ and the remote unit's Source TN (STN) is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the postcondition for R² relinquishment based on data quality and source priority metrics.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU assumes R² for a common track if its local TQ exceeds the received TQ by 2 or more at the time of transmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a quantitative postcondition for assuming reporting responsibility based on TQ differential.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU has not received a remote report for a period of time (40 seconds for Air/Surface tracks, 120 seconds for Land tracks), it assumes R² for the track at the next transmission opportunity, provided local reporting eligibility remains and no remote report has been received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state after successfully assuming track responsibility due to timeout conditions.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU holds R² for a real-time track and receives a remote track report with a Time Quality (TQ) value greater than the local TQ, or where the remote TQ is equal to the local TQ and the remote unit's Source TN is greater, it relinquishes R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state after successfully relinquishing track responsibility due to superior remote track data.

evidence_cards.content: Track reporting criteria for Subsurface (Maritime) Surveillance are based on exchange requirements, with reporting frequency determined by the interface sensor (e.g., non-IU sonobuoy).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the operational state for Subsurface track reporting parameters.

evidence_cards.content: For Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance tracks, the Longitude and Latitude fields in the report shall be set to the position of the acoustic bearing origin.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the required field values (state) for reported Subsurface tracks.

evidence_cards.content: For Subsurface tracks, the Origin TN field shall contain the Track Number (TN) of the detecting unit, track, or point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the required field values (state) for the Originator of Subsurface tracks.

evidence_cards.content: After assuming R2 for a ballistic missile track, the unit is no longer required to assume R2 for the associated launch point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific system state regarding launch points following the management of the ballistic missile track identity.

evidence_cards.content: The unit relinquishing R2 on a ballistic missile track continues to report the launch point in accordance with transmit/receive rules.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific reporting state of the launch point after the main track responsibility (R2) is transferred.

evidence_cards.content: Information differences regarding Identity, Exercise Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, and Environment/Category are resolved by transmitting the appropriate J7 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final action required to complete the resolution of track information differences.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU maintains responsibility (R²) for the track/point as initiated and reported, using a Track Number (TN) assigned from the JU's allocated block.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the enduring state of the track/point managed by the primary actor (C2 JU) after the use case (surveillance data reporting) is successfully initiated.

evidence_cards.content: The standard track identity is determined based on the Exercise Indicator field value: if set to 0 (Non-Exercise Track), the identity is Friend; if set to 1 (Exercise Track), the standard identity is modified by the exercise identity.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific state preservation requirement for the Simulation Indicator field after a status change.

evidence_cards.content: Track alerts (Force Tell and Emergency) allow messages to override all operator-controllable data filters, provided the system is not saturated by these alerts.

evidence_cards.content: When purging a remote track/point automatically, the JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a communication exclusion rule (no Drop Track message) for the post-purge state.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the semantic meaning of the "No Statement" post-state for data fields.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact kinematic data fields that must exist in the system state of the Retained TN after correlation.

evidence_cards.content: An Area of Probability (AOP) is reported using a minimum J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence, with the J3.7I word transmitted with the FIX BRG field set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific output format and field values that must be present on the interface after the system successfully manages the AOP report.

evidence_cards.content: When an AOP is assigned a new Track Number (TN), this new TN is used for all subsequent updates of that AOP.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final state of the track identifier after the transition from a fix to an AOP.

evidence_cards.content: The Platform Evaluation Confidence field of the J3.7C1 word is populated to report the degree of confidence that the emitter's platform is as reported in the Environment/Category and/or Platform fields.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final state of the confidence data field following a successful track evaluation.

evidence_cards.content: The unit originating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report always retains reporting responsibility.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the final state of system ownership/responsibility after a report is initiated.

evidence_cards.content: For a NonC2 JU, the system state must include the processing of J7.0 messages with Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) for locally held remote tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the required system action and state update (processing Drop Track Reports) following the use case of managing track identity and responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: NonC2 JU systems may maintain a state allowing the automatic purge of locally held remote tracks after a specified system-selected time interval if tracks are no longer being updated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final system state regarding track persistence (automatic purging) and the parameterization (system selected time interval) governing that state.

evidence_cards.content: Simulated tracks may be originated from simulated video mixed with live video, from message input provided by previously recorded data, or from an IU reports internal track originator on the Surveillance Network PG.

evidence_cards.content: The type of JU message to be used will depend upon the Environment/Category of the IU being reported.

evidence_cards.content: If the IU system displays both simulated and live tracks simultaneously, the tracks should be readily distinguishable from each other.

evidence_cards.content: When the J3.0 message is used to report a point, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field must be set to value 0, Point, in the initial word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim specifies the exact required state of the J3.0 message format after the C2 JU has processed and reported a point, which is a final outcome of the track reporting process.

evidence_cards.content: For nonslaved moving points, lines, and areas, the C2 JU reports them by setting the Course and Speed fields in the J3.0C2 word to values other than 'No Statement'.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific state of the J3.0 message required to successfully report a nonslaved moving entity.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must extrapolate nonslaved moving points, lines, and areas by the host to the time of transfer to the terminal.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the required calculation state (extrapolation) for the track data at the time of system handoff.

evidence_cards.content: The report for nonslaved moving points must include the Time (Hour and Minute) and Time Function fields.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the required temporal data fields to be present in the post-event message state.

evidence_cards.content: For slaved points reported with a Slaved Indicator = 1, if the J3.0C4 word is included, the bearing is relative to the course of the J3.0C4 Related 1 TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the final bearing relationship state in the message payload based on the presence of specific words.

evidence_cards.content: When the J3.0C4 word is transmitted, the J3.0C2 Related TN field must be set to 'No Statement' for a slaved area, or the J3.0C2 word must not be transmitted for a slaved point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the required field configuration and exclusion rules for slaved areas and points to ensure valid system state.

evidence_cards.content: ASW Areas of Probability (AOP) with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12 shall not be slaved; they must be associated using a J7.7 Association message if no interface correlation exists.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the mandatory handling state for specific AOP tracks, requiring association rather than slaving.

evidence_cards.content: For all other values of the Point Type and Point Amplification fields in the J3.0 message (i.e., those not representing Allied or Hostile Missile Engagement Zones), the Exercise Indicator field is set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a postcondition for the use case when the track is not a Missile Engagement Zone (MEZ); it specifies the required state of the Exercise Indicator field to distinguish these standard tracks from exercise tracks.

evidence_cards.content: If two tracks successfully pass the second correlation test and there is no correlation restriction, they shall be processed for dual designation resolution.

If the detecting sensor is integral to the reporting JU, the Origin TN field contains the TN of the reporting JU; if not, it contains the TN of the detecting unit, track, or point.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific data state (Origin TN and Lat/Long values) in the message after the acoustic reporting action is completed.

evidence_cards.content: Detection and resolution of Identity, Exercise Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, and Environment/Category differences is completed by transmitting the appropriate J7 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the mechanism for resolving data differences (postcondition action) on the interface.

evidence_cards.content: The system state includes the successful recognition and resolution of detected information differences between local data and reported data via interface procedures.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the overall state achieved by the use case (resolution of differences).

evidence_cards.content: When the Exercise Indicator is set to value 0 (Non-Exercise Track), the standard track identity (Friend or Hostile) is used for the track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the resulting system state for tracks not involved in exercises.

evidence_cards.content: When the Exercise Indicator is set to value 1 (Exercise Track), the standard identity of the track is overridden by an exercise identity specified in the Identity Amplifying Descriptor field, which determines the track's status (e.g., NEUTRAL, JOKER, FAKER).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the resulting system state when a track is flagged as an exercise track.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks classified as NEUTRAL are tracks whose characteristics, behavior, origin, or nationality indicate they are neither supporting nor opposing friendly forces.

source_locations.location: Page 4, section 4.4.2.1.1 (IDENTITY), item 'e' (labeled as 'a' in text but logically 'e')
Page 4, section 4.4.2.1.1 (IDENTITY), item 'e' (labeled as 'a' in text but logically 'e')

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state for a specific exercise identity value.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks classified as JOKER are assumed friendly tracks for which the C2 JU has not yet identified the nationality.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state for the JOKER exercise identity.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks classified as FAKER are tracks acting as a hostile for exercise purposes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state for the FAKER exercise identity.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks classified as SUSPECT are tracks that are potentially hostile because of their characteristics, behavior, origin, or nationality.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state for the SUSPECT identity.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks classified as HOSTILE are declared to belong to any opposing nation, party, group, or entity, or are identified by virtue of behavior/information as a threat to friendly forces.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state for the HOSTILE identity.

evidence_cards.content: The standard identity terms are amplified by fields including Exercise Indicator, Identity Amplifying Descriptor, Specific Type, Platform, Platform Activity, and Identity Confidence fields.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the full set of fields that constitute the system's final track identity state.

evidence_cards.content: The locally derived data shall be reported if locally derived IFF/SIF data differs from IFF/SIF data that was being reported in the PPLI message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the data integrity state (the most current data is used) resulting from the track management and reporting flow.

evidence_cards.content: When the Simulation Indicator is set in a J2 or J3 message, all data associated with that track are simulated and should not be associated with a live track; simulated tracks will not be correlated with live tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the state and processing rules for tracks flagged as simulated, ensuring separation from live data.

evidence_cards.content: The system must be capable of displaying both simulated and live tracks simultaneously, with the tracks readily distinguishable from each other.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the display state requirement after the system processes and manages simulated tracks.

evidence_cards.content: The system shall be capable of filtering simulated tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a system capability (filtering) resulting from the track classification and identification process.

evidence_cards.content: When the J3.0 message is used to report a point, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field shall be set to value 0, Point, in the initial word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a required message state (Point/Line/Area Descriptor value) that exists as a result of the track reporting process, constituting a postcondition of reporting a point.

evidence_cards.content: When altitude is specified, Altitude, 100 Ft 1 and, if appropriate Altitude, 100 Ft 2, shall be reported in each J3.0E0 word transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the mandatory content of the altitude reporting system output (presence of specific fields in the transmitted J3.0E0 word) upon a successful report.

evidence_cards.content: If only one altitude is to be reported, the Altitude, 100 Ft 1 shall be used and Altitude, 100 Ft 2 shall be set to value 1023, No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific field values (1023, No Statement) that represent the system state after processing a single altitude report.

evidence_cards.content: The originator of a J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) point, line, or area retains R² as long as the originator remains active and reports the point, line, or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary postcondition of track responsibility (R²) retention by the originating unit during the process of managing track identity.

evidence_cards.content: Another JU may assume R² for a point, line, or area if a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received, the R² unit is declared inactive, or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the specific system conditions and data triggers that result in a transfer of reporting responsibility (R²) to another unit, a key state change in the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The latest IU to report on a reference or land (ground) point, line, or area has R² for the point, line, or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the postcondition for land (ground) points, establishing that the most recent reporter holds the reporting responsibility (R²).

evidence_cards.content: The Exercise Indicator in the J3.0 message is set to value 0 for all Point Type and Point Amplification field values other than value 6 (Area Hazard) with Point Amplification value 3 (Allied MEZ) or 4 (Hostile MEZ).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the final state of the Exercise Indicator field for standard reports, which is a key postcondition of the classification logic (i.e., defaulting to non-exercise).

evidence_cards.content: When a JU transmits an original J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI=0) message or a retransmission due to data change, the Periodic Report Indicator (PER IND) is set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the state of the PER IND field for the initial transmission event following the management of the track identity.

evidence_cards.content: Periodic updates following the original or retransmitted message are transmitted with the Periodic Report Indicator (PER IND) set to value 2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the state of the PER IND field for subsequent updates after the initial report.

evidence_cards.content: Responses to Data Update Requests for multi-point areas or multi-segmented lines are transmitted with the PER IND set to value 0 and the Response Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the state of the PER IND and Response Indicator fields when handling specific request-response flows.

evidence_cards.content: When a remote report being tested for correlation is a J2.0 Indirect PPLI message with the Originator E/C field set to value 0 (Surface) or 3 (Air), it is processed for correlation like a J3.2 air or J3.3 surface (maritime) track with TQ = 7.

source_locations.location: paragraph (c) under the section titled 'Correlation Restrictions'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the resulting system state/processing behavior for a specific message format during track identity correlation.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs do not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data indicates: (1) Identity (ID) difference constitutes a conflict (unless overridden by initialization/operator capability); (2) tracks have different Mode II codes with the local code current (unless overridden); (3) both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks; or (4) either track has Strength > 1.

source_locations.location: Section 'g. Correlation Restrictions' and subsections (1) through (4)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the default system state constraints (postconditions) that inhibit automatic track correlation upon receiving valid surveillance data.

evidence_cards.content: In lieu of specific interface direction regarding the inhibition of automatic correlation due to ID conflicts or different Mode II codes, all IUs will restrict automatic correlation by default.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the final required system configuration state if no specific coordination overrides are in place.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, the JU shall retransmit it as value 1, regardless of other locally held data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific state required for the Special Interest Indicator field upon completion of the retransmission logic for exercise tracks.

evidence_cards.content: Surveillance tracks with differences in position, velocity, or altitude/elevation recognized by the C2 JU are registered through conflict processing, and the C2 JU does not generate a J7.0 (ACT=0) message for them, even though differences may cause other JUs to assume the TN represents two different tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the state of track data (registration through conflict processing without Drop Track generation) after the system handles data differences.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks to the interface until differences in position, velocity, or altitude/elevation are resolved through conflict processing and the J7.0 message is generated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the system state and transmission constraints (no track transmission) after the use case completes.

evidence_cards.content: A JU that assumes R² (Responsibility for tracking) for a ballistic missile track is not required to assume R² for the associated launch point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific state condition after the track management process is applied to ballistic missile tracks, indicating decoupled responsibilities for the missile and its launch point.

evidence_cards.content: A unit that no longer holds R² on a ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with the transmit/receive rules.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the post-condition state for the non-holding unit, allowing it to persist in reporting launch points even after relinquishing responsibility for the missile track itself.

evidence_cards.content: The exchange of Ballistic Missile surveillance information requires procedures to recognize and resolve detected information differences between local data and data being reported on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the requirement to resolve detected differences, which is the intended outcome (postcondition) of the information management process described in this section.

evidence_cards.content: Differences in Identity, Exercise Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, and Environment/Category are resolved by transmitting the appropriate J7 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact action taken to achieve the postcondition of resolved information differences.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on the interface (not remote reports).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific postcondition for the termination of EW surveillance reporting, requiring a specific message type and action value.

evidence_cards.content: The transmission of EW product information is terminated when the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific system state triggers and resulting condition (purging of information) that serves as a postcondition for the management of EW data.

evidence_cards.content: For a track with Identity Amplifying Descriptor value 6 (FAKER), the postcondition is that the track is identified as a friendly track acting as a hostile for exercise purposes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resulting classification state ('friendly track acting as a hostile') after the exercise identity is applied.

evidence_cards.content: For a track with Identity Amplifying Descriptor value 5 (JOKER), the postcondition is that the track is identified as a suspect friend because of its characteristics, behavior, origin, or nationality.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resulting classification state ('suspect friend') after the exercise identity is applied.

evidence_cards.content: For a track belonging to a declared friendly nation, the postcondition is that the track is identified as friendly.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resulting classification state ('friendly') after the exercise identity is applied.

evidence_cards.content: For a track whose characteristics, behavior, origin, or nationality indicate it is neither supporting nor opposing friendly forces, the postcondition is that it is classified as Neutral.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state ('Neutral') resulting from the analysis of track attributes.

evidence_cards.content: For a track which is potentially hostile because of its characteristics, behavior, origin, or nationality, the postcondition is that it is classified as Suspect.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state ('Suspect') resulting from the analysis of track attributes.

evidence_cards.content: For a track declared to belong to any opposing nation, party, group, or entity, or posing a threat to friendly forces, the postcondition is that it is classified as Hostile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state ('Hostile') resulting from the analysis of track attributes.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks must be distinguishable between those involved in special exercises and other live tracks by setting the Exercise Indicator field appropriately in the J3.0 track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resulting system state of the transmitted J3.0 message (Exercise Indicator field value) after the classification process.

evidence_cards.content: When the Exercise Indicator is set to 0 (Non-Exercise Track), the postcondition is that the standard identity of the track is held in the Identity field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resulting data state (Identity field population) when the exercise mode is off.

evidence_cards.content: When the Exercise Indicator is set to value 1, the Identity Amplifying Descriptor field is set to 6 (FAKER), and the track is identified as a friendly track acting as a hostile for exercise purposes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the complete system state for a specific exercise condition.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall accept PPLI information as surveillance data and perform the applicable correlation and conflict processing necessary to ensure that duplicative information is not being transmitted on the Surveillance Network PG.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state after successful PPLI report integration, specifically the completion of correlation and the prevention of duplicate transmissions.

evidence_cards.content: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator shall be reported as No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact values for track identification fields in the post-processing state.

evidence_cards.content: The most current IFF/SIF data shall be reported. If all IFF/SIF nonzero mode codes were obtained from PROCESSING AND MANAGING SURVEILLANCE DATA, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator shall be reported as value 2; otherwise, if Mode II was obtained from the same source as the J2 message, it is 1; otherwise, it is 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the required state for reporting IFF/SIF data based on the origin of the codes.

evidence_cards.content: The Mode IV Indicator value reported shall be based on actual responses received and shall not be based on the Track that the TN was previously associated in a PPLI message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the source of truth for the Mode IV Indicator in the final state.

evidence_cards.content: Simulated tracks shall have the Simulation Indicator set to value 1 in J3 messages and the appropriate field in the J2 message, and all data associated with that track should not be associated with a live track.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the state of a track identified as simulated for training or test purposes.

evidence_cards.content: When a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has responsibility and the Track Numbers (TNs) are the same, the C2 JU accepts the PPLI information as surveillance data but disregards the J3.1 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state following a successful correlation verification in a specific conflict scenario where track identity is accepted but the emergency report is discarded.

evidence_cards.content: For Subsurface tracks, the system state is determined to have no correlation with Independent Units (IUs).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system's handling (lack of association) of Subsurface tracks in the context of correlation management.

evidence_cards.content: When two tracks pass the correlation tests and restrictions, they shall be the subject of a dual designation. The solution is to keep both tracks in main upon the next correlation stimulus, or to correlate them by operator action. If the two tracks successfully pass the second correlation, the same postcorrelation operational contingency constraints (OCC) paragraphs shall be applied.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state and operational status (dual designation) immediately following the successful completion of track correlation.

evidence_cards.content: For tracks that become common local tracks, the following restrictions shall apply: (a) The TN is the subject of a current engagement status message; (b) The TN is the subject of a pending J9.0 Command message or a J12.0 Mission Assignment message; (c) The TN is currently controlled by the JU or controlled by another unit; (d) The TN is an active or inactive IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact contingency constraints and restrictions (Postconditions) that the system must enforce on tracks that have just been correlated and designated as common.

evidence_cards.content: If the received Strength field (J2.2 or J2.3) is set to 0, the PPLI shall not be correlated automatically. However, if a J2.2 or J2.3 with Qpg = 0 is set to No Statement, it may be correlated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the postcorrelation state where the system determines that correlation is not permitted (failure state) based on specific field values, resulting in the track remaining uncorrelated.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it is retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a mandatory system state for a specific field value after processing and assuming responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: Non-No Statement (non-NS) data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit for the track is retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.

source_locations.location: second to last paragraph of section 4.4.4.7

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system's state and data handling requirement for retransmission of specific fields when the C2 JU assumes R².

evidence_cards.content: When a C2 JU assumes R² for a previously-reported track, it accepts all defined field values for retransmission and operator appreciation for the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the state of accepted data fields after the C2 JU assumes responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU receives a J7.0 (ACT=0) message on a locally held track and local reporting eligibility remains, the JU assumes R² for that track at the next transmission opportunity.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific state change where the C2 JU assumes responsibility for a track following a Drop Track message from another unit.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track with TQ field set to 0 assumes R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a postcondition regarding the assumption of track responsibility based on local updates to nonreal-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A JU that receives a J2 PPLI message with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure from a JU with R² may assume R² at the next opportunity, provided local reporting eligibility remains and no remote report has been received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a postcondition where a C2 JU assumes track responsibility in response to a specific PPLI indicator value.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with a Time Quality (TQ) value greater than the local TQ, or with an equal TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the conditions under which the C2 JU state changes from holding track responsibility to relinquishing it.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² on a track retains responsibility until it is relinquished according to the established rules (paragraphs e-i) or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the persistence of the C2 JU's responsibility state regarding the track.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU has resolved conflicts between locally derived information and interface reported information, either by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resolution of a specific conflict state, which is a postcondition of the responsibility management and tracking process.
